name: orbit
title: Orbit
description: Items set evenly on a ring around a centre that turns slowly, the items staying upright, with the centre in the middle; it pauses while hovered or focused, and under reduced motion the ring stands still.

meta.when: Showing that several things connect to one: integrations around a product, sources around a result. Use few items (three to eight) of the same size, each with its own name. For a row of logos use marquee; for a real network use network-graph.
meta.example: <Orbit center={<Logo />} items={[<Icon key="a" />, <Icon key="b" />, <Icon key="c" />]} itemLabels={["Maps", "Charts", "Films"]} />
